2. Speak ONLY the quoted lines, in English, lips still when no line is spoken.
3. Props exist from frame one and never appear, disappear or change design: coat heap, coat on forearm.
4. Never staged, never stiff, never puppet-like; the comedy is in disproportion, not mugging.
5. No readable brand text, logos or signage anywhere in frame.
=== REFERENCE KEY === @image1 character reference; @image2 location still (scene reference only).
CHARACTER: Aubergine utility jacket with four flap pockets, bright circular inspection lamp on a chest strap, tiny clipboard on a lanyard, hair in a tight low bun. Oval face, straight dark brows, small round glasses pushed slightly down the nose, neutral expression that breaks into warm disappointment rather than anger. Costume: Aubergine utility jacket with four flap pockets, chest-strap inspection lamp, tiny clipboard on a lanyard, tight low bun, small round glasses. Same costume in every scene; no brand marks.. Register: Stillness and procedure; comedy comes from disproportion, never from mugging.
CRITICAL - RELIGHT: discard the reference's lighting; relight to the scene as described per shot, with true contact shadows; must look physically present, never a cut-out.
--- S1 (0.0-6.0s) ---
Location: Hallway with coat hooks, early-morning blue hour. Environment: Narrow hallway, plaster wall painted pale grey, one frosted glass door panel at frame-left, wooden rail with five iron hooks: four bare, the fifth bowed downward under the heap of mixed dark coats. Bare floorboards. The Inspector's grey-green coat hangs over her left forearm, held against her jacket.
Action: Locked-off wide: the Inspector stands square to the rail, chest lamp pinned on the bowed fifth hook under a waist-high coat heap. She lifts the clipboard, makes one flat pencil tick, and says her line while the rail creaks.
Performance: Invested task: keep the lamp beam exactly on the sagging hook and log it; eyes fixed on the heap, never the lens, as if the hook might bolt. Micro-expression: Neutral; one slow blink as the rail creaks.
Camera: wide, eye level, locked-off, slightly too formal framing; lens feel 24mm-equivalent phone main camera; movement propped phone with one small settle-wobble in the first half second, then still; rig phone propped on a shoe bench at the far end of the hallway
Lighting: Key: cool blue-hour daylight from the frosted door panel on frame-left, soft and low; fill: the Inspector's chest lamp as a bright circular pool on the heap; colour bounce: pale blue-grey from the plaster wall onto the left side of her jacket, aubergine reading nearly black; contact shadows: hard under the heap where it meets the floor and under each empty hook. Light stability: no light changes between scenes, no room or overhead lights on.
Audio: ambience quiet hallway room tone, faint outdoor birdsong through the door glass; foley: rail creak, exaggerated one notch, pencil tick on clipboard, lamp strap fabric rub, one soft floorboard settle; no music
Dialogue (Inspector, on-camera): "No movement."
ON-SCREEN TEXT: none (added in post).
